verdict.rationale: The Events API has documented URL-path versioning (V1 and V2), a continued-support statement for V1, a dedicated changelog, and a semver'd OpenAPI spec (1.4.1). The Connect API also ships a versioned spec (1.8.1). However, the evidence says no account-wide or Connect-API deprecation policy exists, and the CLI/SDK surfaces have no specs. missing for 10: a formal documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notice), versioning/deprecation coverage for the Connect API, CLI and SDKs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: V1 endpoints remain fully supported for existing integrations that don't require the additional MSP account and user type information
This API reference documents the latest version of the 1Password Events API specifications (1.4.1)
The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1)
